A file listed under `budgets` may not grow past its number (its `wc -l` on the day it was recorded); any file NOT listed may not exceed `default`. When a refactor shrinks a listed file, lower its number in the same commit; when it drops under `default`, delete the line. Raising a number is a reviewed decision, not a fix — say why in the commit. `exempt` files are never counted; each carries its reason.
